evidence.r1: Visible glass is limited to navigation, appearance and purchasing controls in both schemes.
evidence.r2: Lens menu replaces its trigger and selected lens/body rows use flat fills in both schemes.
evidence.r3: Five visible surfaces serve navigation, appearance, body, lens and order without decorative glass in both schemes.
evidence.r4: Top navigation and lower configuration controls share one frosted material character in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear glass is visible; configuration controls are frosted over wooden photographic detail in both schemes.
evidence.r6: All visible controls are neutral without competing action tints in both schemes.
evidence.r7: Light navigation and lens menu pick up the wood’s warm colours through their material.
evidence.r8: Top navigation and lower buttons are capsules; lens menu uses fixed rounded corners in both schemes.
evidence.r9: Nickel selection has an evenly inset smaller capsule within the body selector in both schemes.
evidence.r10: Lower lens and order buttons are capsules in both schemes.
evidence.r11: Bottom bar separates body, lens and purchase into three purposeful groups in both schemes.
evidence.r12: Icon-only appearance control is separate from text navigation and purchase controls in both schemes.
evidence.r13: Each lower selector has a single outer material rather than glass on its internal label in both schemes.
evidence.r14: Bottom three material groups maintain deliberate consistent gaps in both schemes.
evidence.r15: No scroll-edge effect is visible at either floating bar in the supplied light or dark captures.
evidence.r16: Wood grain and camera details remain beneath top and bottom glass in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Hero photograph continues directly beneath both floating bars at rest in both schemes.
evidence.r18: Dark lower price labels are white on mid-grey material; exact threshold compliance is not established.
evidence.r19: Light reduced controls remain readable, but increased contrast and reduced motion states are not shown.
evidence.r20: Camera photograph reaches all window edges behind floating controls in both schemes.
evidence.r21: Only the overlay hero is captured; safe-area clearing of subsequent content is not demonstrated in either scheme.
evidence.r22: Top and bottom controls float directly over the photograph without another backing strip in both schemes.
evidence.r23: Lens-menu endpoint stills cannot establish morphing or press flex in either scheme.
evidence.r24: Top and lower labels are monochrome; warm colour belongs to the photographic content in both schemes.
evidence.r25: Configuration labels are black or white rather than the wood’s brown-orange hues in both schemes.
